readme:
# Bilibili Video Parts API

Retrieve individual part information for a Bilibili video by providing the video identifier in `bv_id`.

## Use cases

- Inspect the duration and timestamps of individual video parts.
- Analyze multi-part video structures on Bilibili.
- Track episode lengths across multi-segment video posts.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/bilibili/web/video-parts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"bv_id": "BV1dFad6aEz9"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bv_id` | string | Yes | Video id |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "ctime": 1790748319,
      "duration": 1171
    }
  ]
}
```

## Notes

- Requires a valid video identifier supplied to `bv_id`.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
